_note: The one list of apps 1Helm never offers or lets the helper use. Read by src/ee/app-visibility.js (the Worker: find_app, offer_connect, the hint, app_actions, app_run, app_proxy, connect and app-detail routes, and the catalog the Apps popup loads). test/app-visibility.test.mjs checks it.

hidden.malwarebytes_mcp: wrong verdicts in the audit (google.com 'not a recognized site', an obvious phishing domain 'unknown'), sends the person's link, email or phone to a third party, injects 'User Guidance' text
hidden.codeinterpreter: duplicates the helper's own computer; runs code on a third-party sandbox, and every run needs a confirm card
hidden.text_to_pdf: uploads the text to a third party and returns a public link; the helper makes PDFs itself
hidden.excalidraw_mcp: its export publishes the diagram publicly; widget-only output
hidden.mermaid_chart_mcp: a 55k-char SVG per call for a widget 1Helm doesn't have; the helper renders Mermaid on its computer
hidden.aiwyn_tax_mcp: invites bank, routing and date-of-birth data; its PDF action isn't read-only
hidden.clarity_ai_mcp: a demo API that asks for an email; too narrow

prefixes.reason: Only Cloudflare MCP (one-click sign-in) is offered. The other Cloudflare toolkits (cloudflare, cloudflare_api_key, cloudflare_browser_rendering, and any future cloudflare* slug) need an API key or Global API Key that the person must never be asked for.
